_doc: General brawls (src/state/brawl.ts, game/workers/brawl.ts). Clashes are only counted and brawls only fought between waves; a running brawl takes over the live-stream split screen (BRAWL badge). Two Generals 'clash' when they bump into each other (closer than clashRadiusPx); a clash counts once per contact (they must part by partRadiusPx first) and only at the pair's same spot (within spotRadiusTiles of where their tension started; a clash elsewhere restarts the gauge there). More than clashesToBrawl clashes fill the tension gauge and start a brawl outside waves. The winner adds the loser's base attack and HP (absorb ratios) and gains one + level (max maxLevel); the loser loses its + levels and bonus and is left at knockoutHpRatio HP. Mirror invaders keep the realm fair: while any General has a +, each wave invader may copy one upgraded General's attack and HP (chance + perLevel × its level, at most one mirror per upgraded General each wave; never bosses).
